### [Germline Variant Calling Pipeline Using GATK](https://github.com/MangoPeachBaNaNa/GermlineVariantCalling_Pipeline_GATK)

A pipeline for identifying germline variants from whole genome sequencing data using the GATK Best Practices workflow.

### [AP-Seq Data Analysis Pipeline](https://github.com/MangoPeachBaNaNa/Analysis-Pipeline-for-AP-Seq-Data)

A pipeline processing raw FASTQ data to metagene profiles of fold enrichment, including code for obtaining raw counts using FeatureCounts.

### [Plasma Proteome Co-Depletion Explorer for Albumin/IgG](https://github.com/MangoPeachBaNaNa/albuminome_interactive_table)

Potential co-depleted proteins/peptides in human blood-based proteomics.
